$comment: Shared contract for task identifiers (docs/specs/TASK_IDENTIFIERS.md, AWTD-1010/AWTD-1016). The server is the only minter; every client parses, autolinks and shows ids against THESE cases. astrid-windows copies this file into contracts/fixtures/, astrid-ios into its test bundle. Change it here first.

parse.note: digits allowed after the first letter
key must start with a letter
the short form is an autolink rule, not an identifier
a uuid is never an identifier

autolink.$comment: Text in, link spans out. Context: `projectKey` is the project whose task or list chat the text belongs to (null outside a project); `keys` are the project keys the reader can see; `hidden` are ids the reader is known not to see. A reference whose key is not in `keys`, or whose id is in `hidden`, renders as plain text — no link that 404s. Full form matches uppercase only, on word boundaries, never inside a URL or code. `#N` needs a projectKey and expands to it. Every link targets /t/<IDENTIFIER>.

cases.name: short form outside a project is plain text
unknown key is plain text, so UTF-8 and COVID-19 stay prose
cases.text: Encode as UTF-8, unlike COVID-19 era code; fixes AITD-5.

cases.name: lowercase is not autolinked (it is still parsed when typed into a picker)
not inside a word or a URL
not inside code
cases.text: Run `git log AWTD-9` then read AWTD-10.

cases.name: #N needs digits only, and a heading is not a reference

showRule.$comment: Where the id is SHOWN (docs/specs/TASK_IDENTIFIERS.md §7). Shown when the task has an identifier AND sits on at least one list that belongs to a project. Surfaces: `details` (next to the lists), `row-board` (muted, board views only), `row-list` (never). 'Copy task id' is offered whenever an identifier exists.

cases.name: moved out of every project keeps the id for links, not for display
